reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "`fluxcd/flux2/action`: Determine latest version without using GitHub API by @RussellAult in https://github.com/fluxcd/flux2/pull/5509", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: behavior-change

consequence.statement: For environments using the fluxcd/flux2 GitHub Action, the latest version is now determined without calling the GitHub API; the action otherwise continues to work.
consequence.remediation: No operator action required; if the mechanism by which the action resolves the latest Flux version matters to your CI setup, verify the workflow behaves as expected.

proposed.statement: The fluxcd/flux2 GitHub Action now determines the latest version without using the GitHub API.
